name: LearnHarness — periodic flashcards + spaced review
goal: Extract flashcards from teacher and learner sessions while the app is open; review them with agent-independent spaced repetition.

change.summary: Expose authenticated app-window lifecycle to the single extraction coordinator and extend notifications after card writes.
change.rationale: App-open extraction must stop even when macOS keeps a resident process.
change.contractChange: Window presence/lease registration and teardown; proposed flashcards-changed event.
acceptance: Two subscribers retain one scheduler.
Last-window shutdown or lease expiry cancels generation.
Existing notifications and reconnect refetch behavior remain intact.
questions: Approve heartbeat lease and minimized/hidden-window interpretation.
constraints: Preserve layer/import boundaries and one semantic writer per store.
Review actions must not invoke agents, teacher wake or graph writes.
change.uncertainty: Draft design, not an exact diff. Product defaults and final names require approval; see flashcards.md.

proposedModules.name: Periodic extraction coordinator
proposedModules.responsibility: Admit bounded extraction only while app-window presence is live.
proposedModules.implementation: Cadence, leases, immutable source batches, claims, cancellation, retries and completion receipts.

interfaces.name: Tick / stop extraction

input.settings: Approved cadence, budget and model configuration

guarantees: One coordinator across windows/module reloads.
No model admission while closed, disabled or unconfigured.
Extraction completion commits cards directly; never teacher wake.
errors: Blocked model, stale source, budget cap or aborted run.
interfaces.effects: May invoke bounded worker; owns cancellation and usage accounting.
interfaces.source: PROPOSED interface; subject to design approval.

change.summary: Add a single periodic, app-open extraction coordinator with independent flashcard coverage.
change.rationale: Current background jobs may wake a teacher, and process lifetime does not match app-window lifetime.
change.contractChange: tick/stop admission + source batch claim + idempotent result commit; no steer delivery.
acceptance: Two windows do not double-extract one batch.
Last-window close/lease expiry stops new work and cancels in-flight calls.
Restart catches up in bounded batches without replaying processed source.
Failed/invalid extraction never advances coverage.
questions: Approve interval, settle delay, window lease semantics, budgets, source-session kinds and activation policy.
constraints: Preserve layer/import boundaries and one semantic writer per store.
Review actions must not invoke agents, teacher wake or graph writes.
change.uncertainty: Draft design, not an exact diff. Product defaults and final names require approval; see flashcards.md.

proposedModules.name: Flashcard extraction worker
proposedModules.responsibility: Generate supported flashcards from teacher explanations and learner answers.
proposedModules.implementation: Dedicated visible-content projection, question/answer pairing, prompt, output schema and anchor validation.

interfaces.name: Extract anchored candidates

input.batch: Immutable source units with session/message IDs, roles, visible content, fingerprints and versions

output.disposition: completed | completed-empty; failures are not empty success

guarantees: Learner answers guide misconceptions; they are not presumed factual answers.
Structured answer/question fields are allowlisted; hidden thinking and unrelated tools excluded.
No file writes, web/shell tools, teacher wake or scheduling authority.
errors: Invalid anchor, unsupported answer, schema failure, cancellation or provider error.
interfaces.effects: Model calls through injected single-submit runtime only.
interfaces.source: PROPOSED interface; subject to design approval.

change.summary: Use a dedicated worker and source projection that includes learner answers without changing graph extraction.
change.rationale: Existing teacher-only graph projection would silently omit half the requested input.
change.contractChange: Bounded candidates with distinct answer-support and misconception-selection evidence.
acceptance: Synthetic misconceptions never become unsupported card answers.
Structured quiz answers are represented without arbitrary tool payloads.
Unknown anchors rejected; zero supported candidates is valid.
No agent/store imports across forbidden boundaries.
questions: Approve prompt wording, card format, acceptance threshold and model-role mapping.
constraints: Preserve layer/import boundaries and one semantic writer per store.
Review actions must not invoke agents, teacher wake or graph writes.
change.uncertainty: Draft design, not an exact diff. Product defaults and final names require approval; see flashcards.md.

proposedModules.name: Flashcard library and reviews
proposedModules.responsibility: Own card content, source provenance, extraction receipts and review history.
proposedModules.implementation: Semantic service over an injected FlashcardStore; append-only evidence, versioned schema, conflict checks and notify-after-write.

interfaces.name: Commit extracted batch

output.receipt: Stable card IDs + committed coverage; prior receipt on retry

guarantees: Cards and receipt/coverage commit as one recoverable unit.
Stale/deleted source refuses; no late resurrection.
Extraction does not overwrite user edits or review history.
errors: Stale source, storage corruption/newer schema, conflicting retry.
interfaces.effects: Durable flashcard evidence write; notify after commit.
interfaces.source: PROPOSED interface; subject to design approval.

interfaces.name: Fetch due cards

output.cards: Saved prompt/answer, provenance, contentVersion, scheduleRevision, dueAt

guarantees: No model calls or credential checks needed for existing cards.
Due state derives from versioned review evidence.
interfaces.source: PROPOSED interface; subject to design approval.

interfaces.name: Record recall rating
guarantees: Idempotent retry; changed payload or stale revision conflicts.
No graph knowledge writes, teacher wake or LLM grading.
errors: Missing card, bad rating, stale content/schedule, storage failure.
interfaces.effects: Append review evidence; update rebuildable schedule cache; notify after write.
interfaces.source: PROPOSED interface; subject to design approval.

interfaces.name: Read extraction progress

output.coverage: Durable committed source keys and receipts
output.cards: Existing card summaries and immutable IDs

guarantees: Independent of graph extraction coverage.
No model call; incomplete runs are not covered.
interfaces.source: PROPOSED interface; subject to design approval.

change.summary: Add a dedicated semantic owner and persistence adapter for cards, extraction receipts and reviews.
change.location: src/core/contracts/flashcards.ts; src/core/ports.ts; src/store/flashcards.ts; src/server/flashcards.ts; stores.ts composition
change.rationale: Keep worker writes and learner reviews consistent without embedding cards in chat messages or graph ledgers.
change.contractChange: FlashcardStore behind commitExtraction/listDue/recordReview; API routes delegate to server barrel.
acceptance: Duplicate review request grades once; same ID/different payload conflicts.
Concurrent grading and extraction preserve both histories.
Crash recovery cannot leave processed coverage without cards.
Corrupt/newer data is explicit failure, not an empty deck.
questions: Approve storage commit protocol, dedup identity, edit semantics, candidate activation and session-deletion policy.
constraints: Preserve layer/import boundaries and one semantic writer per store.
Review actions must not invoke agents, teacher wake or graph writes.
change.uncertainty: Draft design, not an exact diff. Product defaults and final names require approval; see flashcards.md.

proposedModules.name: Spaced-repetition core
proposedModules.responsibility: Calculate the next due state from saved review evidence.
proposedModules.implementation: Pure algorithm with explicit time, versioned parameters and deterministic replay.

interfaces.name: Schedule next review

output.next: Next due timestamp and algorithm state

guarantees: No LLM, IO, hidden clock, server imports or provider keys.
Same evidence and version reproduce the same result.
errors: Invalid transition, unsupported algorithm version or invalid time input.
interfaces.source: PROPOSED interface; subject to design approval.

change.summary: Introduce a versioned pure spaced-repetition transition for v1.
change.location: src/core/flashcards.ts; browser-safe types exported through core barrel
change.rationale: Reviews must keep working offline and produce reproducible due dates.
change.contractChange: Pure scheduling port; algorithm is not selected by this proposal.
acceptance: Pinned reference vectors cover first review, lapse, long gap and repeat success.
No provider calls when reviewing with all model adapters disabled.
Time rollback, timezone changes and algorithm migration have explicit tests.
questions: Approve algorithm/library, rating vocabulary, retention target and migration policy before implementation.
constraints: Preserve layer/import boundaries and one semantic writer per store.
Review actions must not invoke agents, teacher wake or graph writes.
change.uncertainty: Draft design, not an exact diff. Product defaults and final names require approval; see flashcards.md.

proposedModules.name: Flashcard review UI
proposedModules.responsibility: Let the learner review due cards without an agent.
proposedModules.implementation: Due queue, reveal, rating, source links, stable active-card version and event-driven refetch.

interfaces.name: Review page

output.view: Due queue and persisted-card review interaction

guarantees: Prompt → reveal saved answer → self-rate → next due date.
No chat composer, teacher session or model dependency.
New extraction does not reset a card currently being reviewed.
errors: Empty deck, loading, storage failure and stale-review conflict are distinct states.
interfaces.source: PROPOSED interface; subject to design approval.

change.summary: Add a first-class due-card review surface and ordinary local routes.
change.rationale: Learner interaction is separate from generation and remains useful when providers are unavailable.
change.contractChange: Proposed GET cards / POST reviews endpoints and flashcards-changed notify→fetch.
acceptance: Reveal and grade work with no keys/network/model runtime.
Keyboard interaction and focus are usable.
Stale rating conflict prompts refetch rather than grading twice.
Desktop capability guard still protects every endpoint.
questions: Approve navigation placement, card formats, rating labels and manual edit/suspend scope.
constraints: Preserve layer/import boundaries and one semantic writer per store.
Review actions must not invoke agents, teacher wake or graph writes.
change.uncertainty: Draft design, not an exact diff. Product defaults and final names require approval; see flashcards.md.
